note: Per-harness install targets. Verified on this machine 2026-08-31. Every harness discovers skills as <skillsRoot>/<skill-name>/SKILL.md, one level deep, non-recursive, with `name` and `description` frontmatter. That shared layout is why skills/ needs no per-harness transform.

harnesses.name: Claude Code

hooks.form: event map of { matcher, hooks: [{ type: "command", command }] }

notes: Project context is <cwd>/.claude/CLAUDE.md with no ancestor walk-up.

harnesses.name: Codex

hooks.form: same event map as Claude: { hooks: { PreToolUse: [{ matcher, hooks: [...] }] } }

notes: User-scope context only. Project context comes from a standalone AGENTS.md, not <cwd>/.codex/AGENTS.md.

harnesses.name: pi

hooks.form: array of TS/JS module paths, e.g. ["~/.pi/agent/hooks/rewind/index.ts"]

notes: Agent state lives one level down at ~/.pi/agent, not ~/.pi.

harnesses.name: Oh My Pi

hooks.form: default-exported TS factory taking HookAPI, registering pi.on(event, handler)

notes: OMP is the union: it discovers every other harness's skills root, so it needs no install of its own once one of them is populated.
~/.agent[s]/skills is the shared cross-harness location and OMP's own toggle (enableAgentsUser), independent of the Claude/Codex/pi toggles.
Dedup is by skill name, first match wins by provider priority, and identical files are collapsed by realpath. Symlinks from one canonical store are therefore safe; copies into several roots are not.
Sticky rules come only from RULES.md at ~/.omp/agent or the nearest non-empty project .omp/.
